title: Field widgets are validated against datatype -- pick a compatible widget for the field type
body: The platform validates field `widget` against the field's datatype; an incompatible pairing is rejected at authoring time. Use a widget the type supports: text/textarea for string, number/slider for integer, checkbox/toggle for boolean, date/datetime pickers for date types, select/enum for closed-enum fields, `lookup` for reference (FK) fields (gives an automatic browse dialog), plus catalog widgets like color, image-select, and array multiselect for closed-enum arrays. A `custom` trusted-source widget is available for bespoke UI. When in doubt, check the field's type first, then choose from the widgets that type allows.
